misprints.note: π is broken type in the print and looks like 'τ'. I transcribed it as π.
The print has a stray comma before the colon. Kept as printed.
The e is damaged in the print and shows as a blot. I read it as 'eg.'.

uncertain.note: The print shows a full stop and then a single raised dot ('ὁ.·'). The lower dot of the colon is probably missing, so I wrote '.:'.
I can't tell if the accent on κενοί is acute or grave. I wrote acute.
The breathing is tiny and broken. I chose smooth, the standard form.
The ε after κα looks a little like σ (the OCR read δωδεκαστία). I read it as ε, by comparison with δωδεκαετηρίς next to it.
The thousands sign is printed at the lower left, with nothing after the numeral. The same convention is used in 'siffra, ͵ασʹ.'.
